submittedParameters.prompt:
Image1 is the frame to edit. Image2 is the SAME character at the correct fixed-camera physical scale. Match image1 character's physical head/skull size to image2, so they can animate without zooming. Preserve image1 running phase, knee/ankle articulation, foot angles, arm swings, exactly FIVE cards, bell, expression, perspective and style. Only correct accidental camera magnification of image1. Keep same 1254 canvas and fixed camera; don't copy image2's pose or place both characters. One full character with transparent margins.
Output the edited full transparent RGBA sprite at native resolution at least 1024x1024.
